Name: Isabella
Dialog: Any guesses on what Phineas and Ferb have planned for us today?

Name: Buford
Dialog: What?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: This is usually the part of the day when pitch us building your bread bowl hot tub.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I've been burned one too many a time. Maybe it's the universe telling me it's not meant to be.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, guys! Sorry we're late.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What's in the bowl?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (uncovers it) Only our latest invention.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Your latest invention is... a normal-sized ball of dough?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Patience. It still has to rise. Ferb and I invented a new strain of yeast that dectuples in size and bakes itself, in three, two, one...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait, is that bread?! (slaps himself repeatedly) No way! No way! No way! No! (screams)

Name: Ferb
Dialog: May I present—

Name: Buford
Dialog: (covers Ferb's mouth) Lemme say it! Lemme say it! Bread! Bowl! Hot tub! It's finally happening!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You bet your broth! Speaking of which, Ferb, bring in the chowdah! All six hundred gallons!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (in happy tears) Oh, man! I've never been so happy when it wasn't at someone else's expense!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: We were up shucking clams all night.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: We wanted to show Buford that persistence, to the point of being annoying, really pays off.

Name: Candace
Dialog: (offscreen) Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom! Mom!

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Well, sometimes.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Woohoo! (does a cannonball into the tub) Now you guys gonna hop in or what?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: (lying) Well, I would but this is a new bathing suit.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Yeah... I am more of a tomato bisque man.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Since it was your idea, why don't you have a moment alone with your... soup?

Name: Isabella
Dialog: You know what would be good? Let's get a snack.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Okay, your loss! Now this is how we shoulda started summer!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (sighs) You know who would like this? Perry. I wonder where he is.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: It's just a Carb-Away-inator, Perry the Platypus. It's not even evil. It... It sends carbs away.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Having... Argh! Having bread around me is too tempting. So I point it at bread, it sends the bread away.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad? Oh, hey, Perry. I was making a sandwich. Where'd all the bread go?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I dunno. I used the Carb-away-inator, it just goes away. (to Perry) And are you really gonna thwart me for making healthy life choices?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Yeah, I thought so. I thought so. Tell your story walkin', buddy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Was that too mean?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, guys, come on in. The soup is fine.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Guys? Guys? (takes crackers off) Hello, hello? Wait, where am I?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Uh-oh. I've a feelin' we're not in the backyard anymore.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, I don't know how we got here, but my stomach is rumbling. (He gets out of the tub.) Now don't wander off, Chowdina. I'm gonna call ya "Chowdina", cuz, y'know, ya got chowdah in ya. And plus, you look like a Chowdina. Anyway, I'm gonna go bully up somethin' to eat.

Name: Buford
Dialog: I don't know much about the food chain, but I do know that Van Stomms always come out on top. (Cracks knuckles.)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Get in there, fuzz-for-brains.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait for it. Wait for it...

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hyah! Now hold still, ya stupid fishface! (sticks head in stream) Swim in my mouth!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hoo-ya! (gets snared)

Name: Buford
Dialog: Oh, I'm a dumb bird! That's what you sound like! Eat coconut, ya dumb bird!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait a second. (slaps self) I coulda eaten the coconut! Eh, too much work. Sorry, stomach. Turns out I'm a poor provider.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry to come back empty-handed, Chowdina. This whole food chain thing is more complicated than I thought.

Name: British female voice
Dialog: Oh, Buford.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (gasps)

Name: British female voice
Dialog: The beauty of nature lies in harmony.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina, you can talk! But how?

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Well, if I had to guess, you may be hallucinating. My voice is a coping mechanism to deal with the isolation. Although we have only been here for four minutes.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, you're the only one here to talk to. Except for Volley-Baljeet. (He picks up a Wilson-type ball, imitating Baljeet.) "I do not use contractions." (stomach growls) Buford so hungry.

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: You could just eat me. I am made entirely out of food.

Name: Buford
Dialog: What? No! I'm not gonna eat my friend. You're the best thing that's ever happened to me! And the third best thing that's happened to Volley-Baljeet, right? (imitating Baljeet) "My face is blood."

Name: Buford
Dialog: Regardless of how got here, we gotta eat to survive. So it's back to the hunt!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Buford, there are other ways to survive than hunting. You can't bully nature into submission. You must learn to commune with nature.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Bullying's never let me down before.

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's food! My food has food!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Wait! Don't go! I'm not hunting ya! "Commune with nature", huh?

Name: Buford
Dialog: I loves ya, nature.

Name: Nature
Dialog: We love you, too, Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aaaagh!!!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina, you're never gonna believe it! I was so communin' with nature, and—

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina! Get away from her!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: (weakly) It's okay, Buford. Do not worry about me. As you learned in that previous song sequence, this is just part of nature.

Name: Buford
Dialog: But, Chowdina, you cant't go! You're my bread bowl hot tub! And my friend.

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: (coughs) It's the law of nature. You must accept this.

Name: Buford
Dialog: If becomin' one with nature means havin' to leave you behind, I want none of that! Hey, you, trash birds! That's right, ya dirty sky-rats! I've had it with yer stupid squawkin'! Shame! Shame!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, you better fly away, wings-for-arms!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Buford, you went back to bullying just to save me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Yeah, all that nature stuff was gettin' stale anyway.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina, I'm gonna sail ya back to society!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Okay, let's do this!

Name: Buford
Dialog: (screams) Chowdina!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: This isn't looking good, Buford!

Name: Buford
Dialog: It's okay, Chowdina. We're gonna make it through, somehow. This should help with the rain.

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: But I don't think it will do much good against that tidal wave.

Name: Buford
Dialog: No! Listen up, wave! You're not takin' her! For Chowdina, I'll bully the laws of nature into submission! Shame! Shame!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Aaaah! Wait, that actually worked?

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Buford, look!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina, you can fly! I don't believe it! I'm magic!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: How is this happening?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: The call of the carbs was too strong, and I, too weak to resist their charms. I probably shouldn't have built a reverse switch.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: I'll take that!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus? I'm just gonna assume it's you, 'cause I don't hear any talking. Anyway, I was wrong. Please come back and thwart me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Woo-hoo-hoo! Yeah! The power of friendship is amazing!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Sure. Let's chalk it up to friendship.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hold on, Chowdina! We're almost home!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: There's gotta be something you can do to help me with these carb impulses.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Ah. I guess I coulda just done that myself.

Name: Buford
Dialog: We're so close!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Thanks for coming, Perry the Platypus! I appreciate you!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Chowdina! What happened to the magic? Did I do something wrong? It's okay, Chowdina. Even if I have to carry you back, we'll find a way.

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Buford, this is where our journey ends. My time has come.

Name: Buford
Dialog: But we're so close to home! You can't do this to me! Not now!

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Don't think of this as an end, but rather, a beginning. For now, I'll return to the ocean. I'll become food for the fish, breaking down, but nourishing others. Eventually, I'll return to the soil and become a fertile base for wheat to grow. The wheat will be milled into flour and given a purpose. And perhaps one day, I'll become a bread bowl hot tub once again. And you and I can go on a whole new adventure.

Name: Buford
Dialog: (in tears) The circle of life.

Name: Chowdina
Dialog: Thank you, Buford. Thank you for believing in me.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Farewell, Chowdina. Farewell. Chowdina, won't you say goodbye? Oh, that's right. Your voice was just a coping mechanism. "Farewell, Buford."

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Hey, Buford. What happened to your bread bowl hot tub?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Y'know, some days you're flyin' high on a green cloud of friendship magic, while others, you're fish food in the bottom of the ocean.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Um... not sure I follow ya.

Name: Buford
Dialog: She's gone, but she'll live on in my heart forever.

Name: Baljeet, Isabella, and Phineas
Dialog: Phew!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Glad we got outta that one!

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: Who would want to soak in soup?
